Status: Wave 270 accepted (6.3): the first contract-family row (Falcon loggers) and more HawkNET accessors

Method.evidence: Every row read from its own IL through NameCandidates --inspect-methods. The family row is the first use of the --review-families path in this pass: one row carrying the logger family id (170DB9FB...) expanded to its nine members (Class731's abstract declaration plus the logger getters of Class733-741), which the plain wave refuses as virtual-or-override. The thirteen HawkNET rows are single-field accessors: the result code array get/set pair, four loggers, the unload and load device options, the serial number provider get/set pairs (sync and async), and the bus.
Method.themes: Family rows bypass the virtual-or-override refusal because MethodContractFamilies evaluates the family as a whole; the family index built from --review-families (family-index63.py) makes that usable in bulk, and 723 still-free rows across the three modules sit in editable families (Falcon 270, HawkNET 348, DevKit 105). Four HawkConfigurationDataInterfaceObject getters were refused with accessor-operator-or-runtime-special-name (their property rows are obfuscated) and one logger row needed GetFalconLogger because GetLogger is taken on Class460's contract.
